title: Fraud Detection System
summary: An explainable AI fraud-detection pipeline that combines Isolation Forest anomaly detection with SHAP explanations for credit-card transaction data. It uses the standalone ctgan library for synthetic minority-class data augmentation, and calls SDV's metadata schema and evaluate_quality function to validate the generated samples.
